verdict.rationale: cubic acts as a built-in AI teammate that users can direct with explicit commands (e.g. '@cubic-dev-ai review this PR', triggering ultrareview, asking it to generate and push a fix, replying for clarification, enabling auto-approval, or running codebase scans that deploy AI agents), and a community reviewer corroborates that it does more than basic checks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these delegated actions actually completing end-to-end, and evidence of broader (non-review) task delegation beyond the code-review domain.
